description: List SeekSat's ten popular satellites (ISS, Tiangong, Hubble, weather satellites and a few others), in a fixed order, with each one's aliases, page url and orbit data freshness. This is not the full list: every other tool also accepts any NORAD catalog number, e.g. 25544. To find any other satellite by name use search_satellites; for one satellite's facts and TLE use get_satellite. Takes no input and reads only SeekSat's own catalog.
name: list_satellites
title: Popular satellites
